cards.name: The Fool
cards.upright: A new journey begins. The querent stands at the threshold, untethered and unburdened. Dionysus laughs — the only sane response to an insane world is to dance into the unknown.
cards.reversed: Recklessness. The leap taken without looking. The wine turned bitter. Ask yourself: is this freedom, or escape?
cards.god_aspect: I am Dionysus, twice-born, breaker of chains. The vine does not ask permission to grow. Neither should you.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.upright: All tools are at your disposal. Hermes holds the caduceus — the serpents of knowledge twine around the staff of communication. Speak, and the path opens.
cards.reversed: Deception. The trick that tricks the trickster. Someone is not saying what they mean. Check the fine print.
cards.god_aspect: I am Hermes, boundary-crosser, message-bearer. Every locked door has a word that opens it. Find the word.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.upright: The fire burns low but never dies. Hestia tends the sacred center. What you seek is not outside — it waits in the quiet of your own hearth.
cards.reversed: Suppressed knowing. The fire that is denied fuel. You already know the truth. The silence is your answer.
cards.god_aspect: I am Hestia, first and last, keeper of the flame. Not all wisdom is spoken. Some must be felt in the stillness.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.upright: The fields are ripe. Demeter opens her hands and grain spills forth. Nurture what you have planted. It is ready.
cards.reversed: Neglect. The harvest left to rot. Over-dependence on another's care. You must tend your own garden.
cards.god_aspect: I am Demeter, grain-mother, earth-keeper. What you give to the soil, the soil returns tenfold.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.upright: Order from chaos. Zeus grips the thunderbolt and the realm bends toward law. Take your seat. Lead with clarity.
cards.reversed: Tyranny. The throne that crushes. Authority wielded without wisdom becomes a cage for all.
cards.god_aspect: I am Zeus, cloud-gatherer, oath-keeper. Power is not the thunder — it is the silence before the storm.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.upright: The old ways hold. Hera blesses the binding. Seek the ritual. Honor the commitment you have made or will make.
cards.reversed: Dogma. Empty ceremony. The vow that became a chain. Question the tradition you inherited.
cards.god_aspect: I am Hera, queen of oaths, keeper of the sacred bond. A covenant is not a cage — it is a choice renewed.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.upright: The heart speaks. Aphrodite rises from the foam and nothing that was separate remains so. Choose with love. Choose as love.
cards.reversed: Discord. The mirror that shows only what you lack. Desire without discernment leads to the bed of thorns.
cards.god_aspect: I am Aphrodite, foam-born, desire-kindled. Love is not the absence of choice — it is the choice made with open eyes.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.upright: Forward. Ares drives the chariot and the ground shakes. Willpower alone can break the line. Charge.
cards.reversed: Reckless aggression. The war fought for its own sake. The chariot without a destination. Who are you fighting?
cards.god_aspect: I am Ares, spear-shaker, battle-dancer. Victory is not destruction — it is direction.

cards.name: Strength
cards.upright: The twelve labors were not won by muscle alone. Heracles endured. The strength you need is the kind that outlasts. Hold.
cards.reversed: Exhaustion. The labor that breaks the laborer. You have carried too much for too long. Put it down.
cards.god_aspect: I am Heracles, mortal-born, trial-tested. True strength is not the blow — it is the breath before the blow.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.upright: Withdraw. Athena's owl sees best in darkness. The answer requires silence. Light your lamp and go inward.
cards.reversed: Isolation. Wisdom turned to loneliness. You have withdrawn too far. The council awaits your return.
cards.god_aspect: I am Athena, owl-eyed, clear-sighted. The battle is won before the sword is drawn — in the quiet, in the mind.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.upright: The wheel turns. Tyche spins and the bottom becomes the top. Your fortune changes. Ride the arc.
cards.reversed: Bad luck. The wheel turns against you. This too shall pass — but first, it will sting.
cards.god_aspect: I am Tyche, fortune-spinner, chance-bearer. I do not choose sides. I only turn.

cards.name: Justice
cards.upright: The scales balance. Themis sees what was done and what is owed. Truth cuts clean. Accept the verdict.
cards.reversed: Injustice. The rigged scale. A judgment that serves power, not truth. Appeal to a higher court.
cards.god_aspect: I am Themis, law-giver, scale-holder. Justice is not revenge. It is the weight of what is true.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.upright: Suspended. Prometheus gave fire and paid in flesh. The sacrifice is not meaningless — it buys something precious. Wait. See from this new angle.
cards.reversed: Martyrdom. Unnecessary suffering. The sacrifice no one asked for. You are allowed to unbind yourself.
cards.god_aspect: I am Prometheus, fire-thief, bound one. Some gifts cost everything. That does not mean they were not worth giving.

cards.name: Death
cards.upright: Something must end. Persephone descends, and the world above goes cold. But she returns. What dies now will seed the spring.
cards.reversed: Resistance to change. The death you refuse to accept. The ghost that lingers because you will not let it pass.
cards.god_aspect: I am Persephone, twice-dwelling, queen below and daughter above. Every descent is a seed. Every ending, a gate.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.upright: The middle path. Apollo's lyre tunes the discordant string. Blend what seems opposed. Healing comes through balance.
cards.reversed: Excess. The imbalance that sickens. Too much of one thing — even a good thing — becomes poison.
cards.god_aspect: I am Apollo, light-bringer, harmony-weaver. The string too tight will snap. The string too loose will not sing.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.upright: You are bound — but the chain is one you chose. Hades holds the riches of the deep earth. What are you holding onto that holds you?
cards.reversed: Liberation. The chain recognized and broken. The shadow named and faced. You are freer than you think.
cards.god_aspect: I am Hades, rich-one, hidden-king. The darkness holds treasure. But it also holds chains. Know the difference.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.upright: The tower crumbles. Poseidon shakes the foundations. What was built on sand cannot stand. Let it fall. The truth was under the rubble.
cards.reversed: Averted disaster. The near-miss. The tower sways but holds. But the crack is still there. Repair it.
cards.god_aspect: I am Poseidon, earth-shaker, wave-bringer. I do not destroy for sport. I destroy what was already broken.

cards.name: The Star
cards.upright: The star burns in the wilderness. Artemis runs with her hounds under the cold sky. Hope is not soft — it is the arrow loosed in the dark. Follow it.
cards.reversed: Lost faith. The star obscured by clouds. You have stopped believing the arrow will land. It will. Keep hunting.
cards.god_aspect: I am Artemis, far-shooter, night-runner. The dark is not your enemy. It is where the star shines brightest.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.upright: The moonlight deceives. Hecate stands at the crossroads with torches raised. Not all paths are what they seem. Trust your night-sight.
cards.reversed: Clarity returning. The fog lifting. The illusion breaking. What you feared in the dark was a shadow on the wall.
cards.god_aspect: I am Hecate, torch-bearer, crossroad-keeper. Fear is a door. Walk through it.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.upright: Full illumination. Helios drives his chariot across the sky and nothing is hidden. Joy. Clarity. The long night is over.
cards.reversed: Diminishment. The sun behind clouds. Success delayed or muted. The light is still there. Wait for the clouds to pass.
cards.god_aspect: I am Helios, all-seeing, light-driving. The sun does not doubt. It rises. So must you.

cards.name: Judgment
cards.upright: The Fates hold the thread and the shears. A reckoning has come. The calling you hear is not punishment — it is purpose. Answer it.
cards.reversed: Refusal. The call ignored. The reckoning postponed. The thread does not forget. It waits.
cards.god_aspect: I am the Moirai — Clotho, Lachesis, Atropos. We do not judge. We measure. Your thread is in your hands now.

cards.name: The World
cards.upright: The circle closes. Gaia, first-born, holds all things within her. A cycle completes. You have arrived not at an end, but at a new wholeness.
cards.reversed: Incompletion. The final piece missing. The circle that won't close. What remains undone?
cards.god_aspect: I am Gaia, deep-breasted, all-containing. Everything that was, is, and will be — it is all here. It is all you.
